_readme: Launch Week data. Edit this file, then:
npm run seed:check    validate it and print what would be loaded (changes nothing)
npm run seed:local    load it into the local D1 database (npx wrangler pages dev)
npm run seed:remote   load it into the live D1 database (skips entries with "sample": true unless you add --include-samples)
Maker images go in public/launches/<slug>/ and are referenced as /launches/<slug>/logo.png etc.

Entries with "sample": true are placeholders for building and testing. Their images live in test/fixtures/launches/<slug>/ (never deployed; npm run dev serves them). Delete them when the real launches are in.
Re-running the seed updates entries in place and never touches votes. Use --prune to also remove launches deleted from this file.
